subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main WSL2 or Docker reproduction of the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection supports the reporter's hypothesis, but global session-store behavior is compatibility-sensitive and the issue already carries maintainer-review/live-repro labels.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the reported global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
options.body: Accept the source evidence as sufficient and let a repair PR attempt a focused fix plus tests before live proof exists.

options.title: Fold into broader routing review
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer repair until maintainers review adjacent global-session and DM-scope routing semantics together.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reported global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent shipped routing fix and review trail make this the strongest available routing-history owner for the proof-sufficiency call.
